title: Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI
title_zh: 学习测试时的AI辅助代理构建技巧以提升性能

paragraphs.en: Agent performance depends on both reasoning ability and the environment in which it acts. We study test-time AI-for-AI, asking how a Builder can learn to construct better execution environments for a Target while both models’ weights remain fixed. To make the Builder’s experience reusable, we introduce meta-skills : principles specifying when support is needed and what resources to provide. The Builder learns these principles from Target’s execution feedback on the development set, then uses the frozen skill bank to construct harnesses for unseen tasks. Across Harness-Bench and NewtonBench, full-bank meta-skills improve macro-average performance by 8.95 percentage points over no-skill construction, and 12.02 points over direct delivery of the same bank to the Target. These results highlight the value of translating experience into executable support. Gains when the same model serves both roles further suggest a path to system level self-improvement through learning to build better environments.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的表现既取决于其推理能力，也取决于其行动的环境。 我们研究了测试时的“AI为AI”机制，探讨在两个模型权重均保持不变的情况下，“构建者”如何学习为“目标”创建更优的执行环境。 为了使“构建者”的经验能够重复利用，我们引入了元技能：即明确说明何时需要支持以及应提供哪些资源的原则。 “构建者”通过“目标”在开发集上的执行反馈学习这些原则，然后利用固定的技能库为未见过的任务构建执行框架。 在 Harness-Bench 和 NewtonBench 测试中，使用完整技能库的元技能使宏观平均性能比无技能构建提升了8.95个百分点，比直接将相同技能库提供给“目标”提升了12.02个百分点。 这些结果凸显了将经验转化为可执行支持的重要性。 当同一模型同时承担两种角色时取得的进步，进一步表明通过学习构建更优环境，可以实现系统层面的自我改进。

paragraphs.en: An AI agent’s performance depends on both its reasoning ability and the environment in which it acts [ 11 ] . Consider a capable PhD student who spends days repeating experiments because configurations and results are scattered across scripts and notes. An effective advisor can address this bottleneck by establishing a shared experiment log, reproducible tools, and a clear validation workflow, helping the student devote more effort to scientific judgment. This analogy suggests a complementary direction for improving AI agents: learning how to provide the support that makes their existing capabilities more effective [ 3 , 13 ] .

paragraphs.en: AI-for-AI (AI4AI) at test-time offers a route to this goal by enabling AI systems to design agent programs, workflows, and harnesses [ 1 , 15 , 3 ] . This form of AI4AI involves two complementary roles: a Builder , which designs and provides support, and a Target , which uses that support to solve tasks. We study this relationship through harness construction, where the Builder creates a harness comprising instructions, resources, and executable mechanisms for the Target. Just as an advisor learns from a PhD student’s progress to refine their guidance, the Builder can learn from the Target’s execution to improve its support. Building on recent work on meta-level learning [ 13 ] , we therefore ask: how can the Builder turn the outcomes of its own harnesses into reusable knowledge for supporting future tasks?
paragraphs.zh: 测试时的“AI 为 AI”（AI4AI）为实现这一目标提供了一条途径，它使 AI 系统能够设计智能体程序、工作流程和辅助工具 [ 1 , 15 , 3 ] 。 这种形式的 AI4AI 包含两个互补的角色：一个负责设计和提供支持的“构建者”，以及一个利用这些支持来完成任务的“目标”。 我们通过辅助工具构建来研究这种关系，其中“构建者”会创建一个包含指令、资源和可执行机制的辅助工具，供“目标”使用。 正如导师会根据博士生的进展调整指导方式一样，“构建者”也能从“目标”的执行过程中学习，从而改进其支持策略。 基于近期关于元层学习的研究 [ 13 ] ，我们因此提出一个问题：“构建者”如何将自身辅助工具的运行结果转化为可重复使用的知识，以支持未来的任务？

paragraphs.en: To make this experience reusable, we distinguish the knowledge needed by the Builder from task skills used by the Target . Task skills describe how to perform a task [ 9 ] ; the Builder instead needs principles for designing the support that helps the Target perform it. We call these reusable support principles meta-skills . Empirically, each meta-skill shuold specify when support is needed, what capability or resource to provide , and how the Target should use it while retaining responsibility for judgment.
paragraphs.zh: 为了使这一经验能够重复使用，我们将构建者所需的知识与目标智能体使用的任务技能区分开来。 任务技能描述了如何执行某项任务 [ 9 ]；而构建者则需要设计支持原则，以协助目标智能体完成该任务。 我们将这些可重复使用的支持原则称为元技能。 根据经验，每种元技能都应明确说明何时需要支持、应提供何种能力或资源，以及目标智能体在保持判断责任的同时应如何使用这些支持。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we connect the learning and implementation of these principles through a construction–execution–reflection loop. Starting with an empty meta-skill bank, the Builder constructs harnesses for development tasks, reviews the resulting Target execution records and scores, and adds or revises principles based on the observed evidence. After skill learning, the bank is frozen and guides fresh harness construction for each held-out task. Learning thus changes the Builder’s external knowledge and the support it constructs, while both the Builder’s and Target’s model weights remain fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们通过一个构建–执行–反思循环，将这些原则的学习与实施联系起来。 从一个空的元技能库开始，构建者会为开发任务构建工具，审查由此产生的目标执行记录与评分，并根据观察到的证据添加或修订原则。 技能学习结束后，该库将被冻结，并为每个预留的任务指导新工具的构建。 因此，学习过程会改变构建者的外部知识及其构建的支持结构，而构建者和目标的模型权重均保持不变。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate three Targets on Harness-Bench and NewtonBench under fixed Target execution budgets. The full-bank meta-skill Builder achieves a 65.31% macro-average score, exceeding the no-skill Builder by 8.95 percentage points and full-bank independently learned Target skills by 10.93 points. It also outperforms direct delivery of the same bank to the Target in all six settings. These comparisons suggest that meta-skills can help the Builder become a more effective advisor: they guide support design, while Target skills guide task execution. In our setting, teaching the Builder to translate experience into executable support can therefore be more beneficial than directly teaching the Target additional task skills.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在固定的目标执行预算下，对 Harness-Bench 和 NewtonBench 上的三个目标进行了评估。 全库元技能构建器实现了 65.31% 的宏观平均得分，比无技能构建者高出 8.95 个百分点，比全库独立学习的目标技能高出 10.93 个百分点。 在所有六种设置中，它也比直接将相同技能库提供给目标的表现更优。 这些比较表明，元技能可以帮助构建者成为更有效的顾问：它们指导支持设计，而目标技能则指导任务执行。 因此，在我们的设定中，教导构建者将经验转化为可执行的支持，可能比直接教导目标额外的任务技能更有利。

paragraphs.en: Because meta-skills encode reusable principles, we further examine how they develop and whether they remain useful beyond the setting in which they were learned. Through analysis, we discover that repeated reflection can strengthen the guidance, and transfer studies suggest possible meta-skill reuse across Builders and Targets. The Builder and Target can also be instances of the same model: across three such settings, meta-skills improve scores by 18.71 points on average over no-skill construction. These results suggest that a model can improve its own execution by learning to build better support for itself, establishing harness design as a promising route to system-level self-improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 由于元技能编码了可重复使用的原则，我们进一步研究了它们如何发展，以及它们在超出学习环境的场景下是否仍然有用。 通过分析我们发现，反复反思可以强化其指导作用，而迁移研究则表明元技能可能在不同构建器和目标之间被重复使用。 构建器和目标也可以是同一模型的不同实例：在三种此类设置中，与无技能构建相比，元技能使得分平均提高了 18.71 分。 这些结果表明，一个模型可以通过学习为自己构建更好的支持来改进自身的执行过程，这确立了“驾驭设计”作为实现系统级自我提升的一条有前景的途径。

paragraphs.en: AI-for-AI uses AI systems to automate model development and agent design. For model development, AIDE uses an LLM agent to write and refine machine-learning pipelines, while MLE-Dojo provides environments for training and evaluating agents performing this engineering work [ 2 , 6 ] . For test-time agent design, the optimization target becomes the system surrounding a fixed model: Automated Design of Agentic Systems and AFlow both focus on searching agent programs and workflows [ 1 , 15 ] , while Darwin Godel Machine evolves its own agent code, and Meta-Harness searches harness implementations using execution feedback [ 14 , 3 ] . Within this direction, strong-to-weak harness construction uses a stronger Builder to supply executable support for a weaker Target [ 5 ] . We build on this setting by learning reusable construction principles from Target executions during offline skill learning, then freezing them to guide fresh harness construction for each test task, with both models’ weights fixed.
paragraphs.zh: AI-for-AI 利用人工智能系统来自动化模型开发和智能体设计。 在模型开发方面，AIDE 使用一个 LLM 智能体来编写和优化机器学习流程，而 MLE-Dojo 则为执行这些工程工作的智能体提供训练和评估环境 [ 2 , 6 ] 。 在测试时的智能体设计方面，优化目标转变为围绕固定模型的整个系统：Automated Design of Agentic Systems 和 AFlow 都专注于搜索智能体程序和流程 [ 1 , 15 ] ，而 Darwin Godel Machine 则演化其自身的智能体代码，Meta-Harness 则通过执行反馈来搜索 harness 实现 [ 14 , 3 ] 。 在这一方向中，强到弱 harness 构建方法使用一个更强的 Builder 为较弱的 Target 提供可执行的支持 [ 5 ] 。 我们在此基础上进行扩展：在离线技能学习阶段，从 Target 的执行中学习可重用的构建原则，然后将其冻结，以指导每个测试任务的 new harness 构建，同时两个模型的权重均保持固定。

paragraphs.en: Agent skills preserve procedural knowledge for reuse: Voyager stores executable routines, while ExpeL and Agentic Context Engineering accumulate textual insights and contextual playbooks [ 7 , 17 , 16 ] . Methods for improving these resources include SkillRL, which co-evolves skills and policies through reinforcement learning, and Evo-Harness, which compiles execution experience into transferable solver skills [ 10 , 9 ] . SkillsBench complements these methods by measuring skill utility with curated packages and deterministic verifiers [ 4 ] . At the meta level, learned knowledge guides agent improvement itself: Meta Context Engineering learns skills for constructing context files and code, while MetaSkill-Evolve evolves policies for improving task skills [ 13 , 8 ] . Within this direction, our Builder learns those principles from its own harness outcomes and implements them as task-specific environments for a separate Target , specifying when support is needed, what capabilities to supply, and the Target’s responsibilities.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体技能保留了可重复使用的程序性知识：Voyager 存储了可执行的程序，而 ExpeL 和 Agentic Context Engineering 则积累了文本洞察和上下文剧本 [ 7 , 17 , 16 ] 。 改进这些资源的方法包括 SkillRL，它通过强化学习共同演化技能和策略；以及 Evo-Harness，它将执行经验编译为可迁移的求解器技能 [ 10 , 9 ] 。 SkillsBench 通过利用精心挑选的包和确定性验证器来衡量技能的效用，从而补充了这些方法 [ 4 ] 。 在元层面上，学习到的知识指导智能体自身的改进：Meta Context Engineering 学习构建上下文文件和代码的技能，而 MetaSkill-Evolve 则演化用于提升任务技能的策略 [ 13 , 8 ] 。 在这一方向上，我们的 Builder 从自身的执行结果中学习这些原则，并将其实现为特定任务的環境，用于一个独立的 Target，明确说明何时需要支持、应提供哪些能力以及 Target 的职责。

paragraphs.en: At the end of each skill-learning step, the Builder reviews its generated harnesses and the Target’s execution feedback to identify an observed error or recurring burden that better support could address, then compares the resulting lesson with the current bank. It revises an existing meta-skill when the evidence corrects or strengthens its guidance, adds a new meta-skill for a distinct reusable support need, or keeps the bank unchanged when no update is justified. Each batch permits at most one addition or revision, which must cite supporting evidence from that batch to keep the learned guidance grounded in observed behavior.

paragraphs.en: The Target operates within a Builder-created harness, while the Builder operates within a framework we design. Specifically, we provide shared interfaces, execution isolation, design guidance, and resource limits, with identical construction permissions and bounded interface-repair opportunities across conditions. These fixed priors underpin our workflow for automated meta-skill learning, harness construction, and Target execution. Our contribution thus shifts design effort to the Builder level, enabling it to turn execution experience into reusable support principles and adapt their implementation to individual tasks.

paragraphs.en: We present the main results and baselines in Table 3 , and highlight the following key findings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在表 3 中展示了主要结果和基线方法，并重点介绍了以下关键发现。

paragraphs.en: Giving the same full meta-skill bank to the Builder consistently outperforms giving it directly to the Target , improving every model–benchmark pair by up to 25.43 points and 12.02 on average. This gap shows that the gains come not merely from exposing the Target to better knowledge, but from operationalizing that knowledge before execution. The Builder can translate a declarative meta-skill into persistent state, executable tools, verification logic, or control decisions, reducing the burden on the Target to interpret and apply the advice correctly at inference time. Meta-skills therefore function less as solver prompts and more as a compact language for provisioning task-specific support.
paragraphs.zh: 持续将相同的完整元技能库赋予构建者，其表现优于直接将其赋予目标，所有模型-基准组合的得分提升最多可达25.43分，平均提升12.02分。 这一差距表明，性能提升并非仅仅源于让目标接触更优质的知识，而是源于在执行前将这种知识转化为可操作的形式。 构建者能够将声明式的元技能转化为持久状态、可执行工具、验证逻辑或控制决策，从而减轻目标在推理阶段正确解读和应用建议的负担。 因此，元技能的作用与其说是解题提示，不如说是一种为任务提供特定支持的紧凑型语言。

paragraphs.en: With construction capability held fixed, the full-bank Builder outperforms the no-skill Builder in all six settings, with an average gain of 8.95 points. These results suggest that experience adds value beyond the ability to construct scaffolds: it helps the Builder decide which support to build and how to integrate it with Target behavior. The gains nevertheless vary across Targets and benchmarks, suggesting that accumulated guidance must be adapted to the Target and task rather than assumed uniformly useful.
paragraphs.zh: 在建造能力保持不变的情况下，全技能建造者在所有六种设置中均优于无技能建造者，平均提升 8.95 分。 这些结果表明，经验带来的价值超越了搭建脚手架的能力：它帮助建造者决定要构建哪种支撑结构，以及如何将其与目标行为相整合。 然而，这种提升在不同目标和基准测试中存在差异，这表明积累的引导必须根据具体目标和任务进行调整，而不能假设其具有普遍适用性。

paragraphs.en: Relative to the no-skill Builder, gains on NewtonBench are positive across all three Targets and average 10.96 points, versus 6.95 points on Harness-Bench. NewtonBench requires agents to coordinate experimentation, reasoning, and valid symbolic submission, creating recurring coordination failures that scaffolding can address. Harness-Bench spans more heterogeneous workflows, where effective support depends more on Target-specific planning and tool use . This contrast suggests that accumulated experience is most useful when failure modes recur consistently across tasks and Targets.
paragraphs.zh: 与无技能的 Builder 相比，NewtonBench 在所有三个目标上的增益均为正值，平均为 10.96 分，而 Harness-Bench 的平均值为 6.95 分。 NewtonBench 要求智能体协调实验、推理和有效的符号提交，这会导致反复出现的协调失败，而脚手架机制可以解决这些问题。 Harness-Bench 涵盖了更多异构的工作流程，其中有效的支持更依赖于针对特定目标的规划和工具使用。 这种对比表明，当失败模式在不同任务和目标中持续重复出现时，积累的经验最为有用。

paragraphs.en: The full skill bank outperforms top-2 retrieval in five of six settings, with an average gain of 7.19 points on NewtonBench. This pattern suggests that a compact meta-skill bank offers complementary procedures whose combined value may be missed by lexical retrieval. Full-bank access allows the Builder to consider these procedures together when designing support, making it a strong default at the evaluated scale. The exception, however, indicates that broader access is not uniformly beneficial and motivates retrieval methods that account for both skill complementarity and the Target’s likely response to support.
paragraphs.zh: 在六种设置中，完整技能库在五种设置中的表现优于前2名检索方法，在 NewtonBench 上的平均提升为 7.19 分。 这一模式表明，一个紧凑的元技能库提供了互补的流程，其综合价值可能无法通过词汇检索被捕捉到。 完整技能库的访问权限允许构建者在设计支持时将这些流程一并考虑，因此在所评估的规模上，它成为一个强有力的默认选择。 然而，这一例外表明，更广泛的访问权限并非总是有益的，这也促使我们开发能够同时考虑技能互补性和目标对支持的潜在反应的检索方法。

paragraphs.en: Across the three settings in Figure 3 (a), Builder meta-skills yield average gains of 18.71 points over no-skill construction and 14.14 points over skills delivered directly to the Target. These results identify an additional axis of optimization: improving how a model equips itself, without weight updates or a stronger teacher. This mechanism could complement the Target’s own skill learning: as the Target’s capabilities improve, the Builder could adapt its support to the Target’s changing needs, while execution feedback informs further support refinement. Self-evolution could therefore involve coordinated improvement in both task-solving capabilities and the environments that support them.
paragraphs.zh: 在图 3(a) 的三种设置中，构建者元技能相较于无技能构建平均提升了 18.71 分，相较于直接提供给目标方的技能则平均提升了 14.14 分。 这些结果揭示了一个额外的优化维度：在不更新模型权重或引入更强教师模型的情况下，改进模型自我装备的方式。 这种机制可以补充目标方自身的技能学习过程：随着目标方能力的提升，构建者能够根据目标方不断变化的需求调整支持方式，同时执行反馈也能指导进一步的支持优化。 因此，自我演化可能涉及任务解决能力与支持这些能力的环境之间的协同改进。

paragraphs.en: On NewtonBench, the Sol-to-Qwen bank yields a 13.36-point gain with Sol but a 4.45-point decline when transferred to Gemini-Pro; on Harness-Bench, the same transfer instead yields a 2.72-point gain. These results support the feasibility of cross-Builder reuse, although all confidence intervals include zero, leaving the performance benefits uncertain. The differing outcomes suggest that transfer depends partly on how the receiving Builder translates shared lessons into a harness : even the skill bank is fixed, different Builders may implement the same guidance differently. Refining the resulting harness through execution feedback may therefore help realize the value of transferred meta-skills.
paragraphs.zh: 在 NewtonBench 上，Sol-to-Qwen 技能库在 Sol 模型上带来了 13.36 分的提升，但在迁移到 Gemini-Pro 时却下降了 4.45 分；而在 Harness-Bench 上，同样的迁移反而带来了 2.72 分的提升。 这些结果支持跨 Builder 重用的可行性，尽管所有置信区间都包含零，因此性能提升的具体效果仍不确定。 不同的结果表明，迁移效果部分取决于接收方 Builder 如何将共享的教训转化为执行框架：即使技能库是固定的，不同 Builder 也可能以不同方式实现相同的指导原则。 因此，通过执行反馈来优化由此产生的执行框架，可能有助于释放迁移元技能的真正价值。

Recipient-side learning may therefore complement cross-Builder reuse: imported skills provide reusable guidance, while feedback from the recipient’s harnesses offers a basis for refining that guidance.

The accompanying confidence intervals quantify uncertainty in this average effect across test tasks.

paragraphs.en: Removing the controller lowers scores for all three Targets: by 13.36 points for Gemini, 4.79 for Qwen, and 1.03 for GPT-OSS. These consistent observed drops support the controller’s role in improving execution, although only Gemini’s confidence interval excludes zero. The size of the benefit varies with both Target behavior and controller design : each ablation isolates the controller within a frozen harness, but its functions may differ across Targets, including experiment sequencing, state tracking, or submission management. Effective harness design therefore uses external coordination where it helps, tailoring the controller’s functions to each Target’s execution needs.
paragraphs.zh: 移除控制器后，所有三个目标的得分均有所下降：Gemini 下降 13.36 分，Qwen 下降 4.79 分，GPT-OSS 下降 1.03 分。 这些持续观察到的下降支持了控制器在提升执行效果方面的作用，尽管只有 Gemini 的置信区间排除了零值。 这种收益的大小既取决于目标行为，也取决于控制器设计：每次消融实验都在固定的框架内隔离了控制器，但其功能可能因目标而异，包括实验顺序安排、状态跟踪或提交管理。 因此，有效的框架设计会在有帮助时利用外部协调，并根据每个目标的执行需求定制控制器的功能。

sents.en: Removing the controller lowers scores for all three Targets: by 13.36 points for Gemini, 4.79 for Qwen, and 1.03 for GPT-OSS.

sents.en: These consistent observed drops support the controller’s role in improving execution, although only Gemini’s confidence interval excludes zero.
sents.zh: 这些持续观察到的下降支持了控制器在提升执行效果方面的作用，尽管只有 Gemini 的置信区间排除了零值。

sents.en: The size of the benefit varies with both Target behavior and controller design : each ablation isolates the controller within a frozen harness, but its functions may differ across Targets, including experiment sequencing, state tracking, or submission management.
sents.zh: 这种收益的大小既取决于目标行为，也取决于控制器设计：每次消融实验都在固定的框架内隔离了控制器，但其功能可能因目标而异，包括实验顺序安排、状态跟踪或提交管理。

sents.en: Effective harness design therefore uses external coordination where it helps, tailoring the controller’s functions to each Target’s execution needs.
sents.zh: 因此，有效的框架设计会在有帮助时利用外部协调，并根据每个目标的执行需求定制控制器的功能。

paragraphs.en: Retaining memory plus context yields small positive estimated effects for Gemini and Qwen and a negative effect for GPT-OSS, although all three confidence intervals contain zero. These estimates suggest potential benefits for some Targets, but do not establish a reliable aggregate effect. Additional state can preserve useful evidence, while its value depends on keeping that evidence relevant and avoiding redundant or outdated information. Meta-skills therefore should support selective state exposure by guiding what to retain and when to surface it for the Target .
paragraphs.zh: 保留记忆和上下文信息对 Gemini 和 Qwen 产生了较小的正向估计效应，而对 GPT-OSS 则产生了负向效应，尽管三者的置信区间都包含了零。 这些估计结果表明某些目标可能会受益，但并未确立可靠的总体效应。 增加状态可以保留有用的证据，但其价值取决于能否保持这些证据的相关性，并避免冗余或过时的信息。 因此，元技能应通过指导保留哪些信息以及何时向目标呈现这些信息，来支持对状态的有选择性暴露。

paragraphs.en: On NewtonBench, cases with no valid submission fall from 394 to 254 (35.5%), while correct discoveries rise from 439 to 535 (21.9%). Transitions include 145 recoveries from no valid submission to a correct law, versus 46 regressions. This suggests more reliable completion of the scientific loop, creating opportunities for correct discovery. Valid-but-incorrect submissions also rise from 43 to 87, showing that completion enables but does not guarantee correctness. On Harness-Bench, full successes increase from 59 to 67, largely through transitions from partial to full success. This suggests that meta-skills help agents satisfy remaining requirements and turn partial progress into complete task fulfillment .
paragraphs.zh: 在 NewtonBench 上，没有有效提交的案例从 394 个降至 254 个（下降 35.5%），而正确发现的案例则从 439 个增至 535 个（上升 21.9%）。 状态转换包括 145 次从“无有效提交”到“正确定律”的恢复，以及 46 次倒退。 这表明科学循环的完成过程更加可靠，从而为正确发现创造了机会。 有效但不正确的提交案例也从 43 个增至 87 个，说明任务的完成虽能促进正确性，但并不能保证正确性。 在 Harness-Bench 上，完全成功的案例从 59 个增至 67 个，这主要得益于从部分成功到完全成功的状态转换。 这表明元技能有助于智能体满足剩余要求，并将部分进展转化为任务的完全完成。

paragraphs.en: All three Targets improve overall on NewtonBench by 6.85–13.36 points, with positive category-level point estimates for gravity, radioactive decay, and Hooke’s law across models. Harness-Bench shows gains for every Target on SRE/release tasks, with mixed effects elsewhere. GPT-OSS improves by 5.20 points overall but declines by 2.23 points on vertical workflows, illustrating that a positive aggregate gain can coexist with category-specific regressions. These recurring gains suggest shared support needs across models, while the remaining variation points to the importance of Target–task compatibility. This further motivates reusing support principles while adapting their implementation to each Target’s capabilities and the task’s demands.
paragraphs.zh: 所有三个目标在 NewtonBench 上的总体得分均提升了 6.85–13.36 分，且各模型在重力、放射性衰变和胡克定律等类别上的得分估计值均为正值。 Harness-Bench 显示，每个目标在 SRE/release 任务上均有提升，但在其他任务上的效果则参差不齐。 GPT-OSS 的总体得分提升了 5.20 分，但在垂直工作流上的得分下降了 2.23 分，这表明总体正向增益可能与特定类别的退步同时存在。 这些反复出现的提升表明各模型存在共同的支持需求，而其余的差异则凸显了目标与任务兼容性的重要性。 这进一步说明，在适应每个目标的能力及任务需求的同时，应重新运用支持原则并调整其具体实施方法。

paragraphs.en: Same-model studies show that a model can improve its own test-time execution by learning to construct better harnesses, while its weights remain fixed. Our evidence spans one main Builder, two benchmarks, and one adopted execution per task and condition. Establishing broader applicability requires more diverse Builders and tasks, and evaluation of performance gains relative to construction cost, which we leave to future works.
paragraphs.zh: 同模型研究表明，模型可以通过学习构建更优的测试时执行框架来改进自身的测试时执行效果，而模型的权重则保持不变。 我们的证据涵盖了一个主要 Builder、两个基准测试，以及每个任务和条件下采用的一种执行方式。 要确立更广泛的可适用性，需要更多样化的 Builder 和任务，并评估性能提升相对于构建成本的收益，这部分工作我们留待未来研究。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduced meta-skill that enable a Builder to learn reusable support principles from the execution outcomes of its own harnesses and implement them for unseen tasks. With both models’ weights fixed, full-bank meta-skills improve macro-average performance across Harness-Bench and NewtonBench by 8.95 percentage points over no-skill construction and 12.02 points over direct delivery of the same bank to the Target. These comparisons highlight the value of translating experience into executable support: a lesson can guide the construction of tools, state, and control mechanisms that help the Target apply its capabilities during execution. Outcome analyses connect these gains to more reliable task completion, while component and transfer results point to the importance of adapting reusable principles to each model and task. Same-model experiments further demonstrate that a model can self-improve by learning to build better support for itself. Together, these findings identify support design as a complementary axis of agent improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们引入了一种元技能，使构建智能体能够从其自身工具链的执行结果中学习可重用的支持原则，并将其应用于未见过的任务。 在两个模型权重固定的情况下，全银行元技能在 Harness-Bench 和 NewtonBench 上的宏观平均性能相比无技能构建提升了 8.95 个百分点，相比将相同银行直接交付给目标智能体则提升了 12.02 个百分点。 这些对比凸显了将经验转化为可执行支持的重要性：一个经验教训可以指导工具、状态和控制机制的构建，从而帮助目标智能体在执行过程中有效运用其能力。 结果分析将这些性能提升与更可靠的任务完成联系起来，而组件和迁移结果则表明，将可重用的原则适配到每个模型和任务至关重要。 同一模型实验进一步证明，模型可以通过学习如何为自己构建更有效的支持机制来实现自我改进。 综合来看，这些发现确立了支持设计作为智能体改进的一个补充维度。

paragraphs.en: This work studies automated harness design using existing agent-workflow and simulated scientific-discovery benchmarks. Experiments use isolated execution environments and bounded resources, with development and test tasks separated and meta-skill banks frozen before evaluation to preserve evaluation integrity. Because generated tools and controllers can enable unintended or harmful actions, applications beyond these benchmarks should incorporate restricted permissions, validation of generated components, and human oversight appropriate to the application.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究利用现有的智能体-工作流和模拟科学发现基准，探讨了自动化约束设计。 实验采用隔离的执行环境和有限的资源，开发任务与测试任务相互分离，并在评估前冻结元技能库，以维护评估的完整性。 由于生成的工具和控制器可能引发意外或有害的操作，因此超出这些基准的应用程序应包含权限限制、对生成组件的验证，以及符合应用需求的人工监督机制。

paragraphs.en: We discuss the significance of Builder learning and highlight the core contributions of this study.
paragraphs.zh: 我们探讨了 Builder 学习的重要性，并强调了本研究的核心贡献。

paragraphs.en: Learning to Design Useful Support. We study how a Builder can turn experience into reusable principles for supporting (or harnessing) a Target. These meta-skills specify when support is needed, what to provide, and how the Target should use it. They guide fresh harness construction on subsequent tasks, allowing the Builder to carry forward design knowledge while adapting its implementation to each task. This makes support design itself an object of learning.
paragraphs.zh: 学习设计有效的支持。 我们研究构建者如何将经验转化为可重复使用的原则，以支持（或利用）目标。 这些元技能明确了何时需要支持、需要提供什么，以及目标应如何使用它。 它们指导后续任务中新利用机制的构建，使构建者能够在适应每个任务的实现方式的同时，延续设计知识。 这使得支持设计本身成为学习的一个对象。

sents.en: Learning to Design Useful Support.

paragraphs.en: Turning Experience into Executable Support. In the main study, giving the full skill bank to the Builder yields higher scores than giving the same bank directly to the Target in all six settings. This highlights the value of translating guidance into tools, state, and execution control that the Target can use. The same-model experiments further illustrate a route to system-level self-improvement: a model can use execution experience to learn how to equip itself more effectively, with its weights unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 将经验转化为可执行的支持。 在主研究中，在所有六种设置中，向构建者提供完整的技能库所获得的分数，高于直接向目标提供相同技能库的分数。 这凸显了将指导转化为目标能够使用的工具、状态和执行控制的重要性。 同模型实验进一步说明了一条系统级自我改进的路径：模型可以利用执行经验来学习如何更有效地装备自身，而无需改变其权重。

paragraphs.en: We explain the rationale for our experimental settings and clarify the conclusions supported by our results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们阐述了实验设置的依据，并阐明了结果所支持的研究结论。

paragraphs.en: Contribution within test-time AI4AI. We study how experience improves a Builder’s ability to support a Target while both models’ weights remain fixed. Closely related work learns solver guidance, as in Evo-Harness [ 9 ] ; searches executable harness implementations, as in Meta-Harness [ 3 ] ; or evolves strategies for engineering context files and code, as in Meta Context Engineering [ 13 ] . Our focus is reusable knowledge for support design: the Builder extracts principles from its own harness outcomes, specifying when support is needed, what to provide, and how the Target should use it. These principles subsequently guide fresh construction for held-out tasks. Our contribution combines this learning and deployment protocol with controlled evidence on the value of accumulated Builder experience and its implementation as task-specific support.
paragraphs.zh: 测试阶段 AI4AI 中的贡献。 我们研究了经验如何提升构建者（Builder）在两个模型权重均保持不变的情况下支持目标（Target）的能力。 相关研究包括：学习求解器引导，如 Evo-Harness [9]；搜索可执行的测试框架实现，如 Meta-Harness [3]；或演化用于工程上下文文件和代码的策略，如 Meta Context Engineering [13]。 我们的重点是支持设计中的可复用知识：构建者从自身测试框架的结果中提取原则，明确何时需要支持、提供什么内容以及目标应如何使用这些支持。 这些原则随后会指导对新保留任务的构建过程。 我们的贡献将这一学习与部署协议，与关于积累构建者经验及其作为任务特定支持之价值的受控证据相结合。

paragraphs.en: Shared framework and interpretation of the comparisons. All Builder conditions share component interfaces, design guidance, construction permissions, and bounded repair opportunities. The no-skill Builder assesses the additional value of learned guidance under the same construction allowance. Direct-bank baselines preserve the skill content and assess the benefit of having a Builder implement it before execution, while independently learned Target skills and mined notes provide alternative routes for applying experience to task solving. Full-bank macro-average gains of 8.95 points over no-skill construction and 12.02 points over direct delivery support the value of learning and implementing support principles within this framework. These comparisons fix Target execution limits; learning and construction fall outside those limits, with construction allowances matched across Builder conditions. Frozen-harness ablations examine component contributions within the resulting implementations, and case studies illustrate how principles become executable support. Their Target-dependent results, including the clear controller benefit for Gemini-3.6-Flash, support adapting available components to the recipient’s needs.
paragraphs.zh: 共享框架与比较结果的解读。 所有 Builder 条件都共享组件接口、设计指导、构建权限以及有限的修复机会。 无技能 Builder 会评估在相同构建许可下，所学指导带来的额外价值。 直接银行基线保留了技能内容，并评估了在执行前由 Builder 实现该技能的收益；而独立学习的目标技能和挖掘出的笔记则为将经验应用于任务解决提供了替代路径。 全银行宏观平均增益显示：相比无技能构建提升了 8.95 分，相比直接交付提升了 12.02 分，这支持了在此框架内学习和实施支持原则的价值。 这些比较固定了目标执行限制；学习与构建均处于这些限制之外，且各 Builder 条件的构建许可保持一致。 冻结约束消融分析研究了最终实现中各组件的贡献，而案例研究则展示了这些原则如何转化为可执行的支持。 这些结果依赖于目标，包括对 Gemini-3.6-Flash 而言明显的控制器优势，支持将可用组件适配到接收方的需求。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation protocol and reproducibility. Skill acquisition uses development episodes, and the bank is frozen before testing. Each test harness is constructed from the public task input and the supplied bank, without access to test execution feedback or reference answers. Appendices B and C document the core settings: the partitioning procedure, information access, model choices, resource limits, baseline configurations, failure accounting, and paired task-bootstrap procedures. All declared test tasks remain in the evaluation denominator, and reported intervals characterize uncertainty across paired test instances. Upon paper acceptance, we will release the full code and all prompts for skill learning, harness construction, baseline runs, and evaluation, together with the experimental configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 评估协议与可重复性。 技能获取使用开发阶段，且测试前会冻结知识库。 每个测试框架均基于公开的任务输入和提供的知识库构建，无法访问测试执行反馈或参考答案。 附录 B 和 C 记录了核心设置：划分流程、信息访问权限、模型选择、资源限制、基线配置、失败统计以及任务-引导成对流程。 所有已声明的测试任务均保留在评估分母中，所报告的置信区间则描述了成对测试实例之间的不确定性。 论文被接受后，我们将发布完整的代码以及技能学习、框架构建、基线运行和评估所需的所有提示词，同时一并公开实验配置。

paragraphs.en: Generalization to new tasks within each benchmark. Banks learned from approximately 10% of each benchmark guide construction on the remaining held-out instances, with full-bank improvements over no-skill construction in all six settings. This establishes the usefulness of accumulated experience for new tasks within known categories and mechanisms, covering both workflow execution and scientific discovery. Cross-dataset reuse is a natural extension beyond this evaluation scope and is left to future work. A promising hypothesis is that skill granularity is central to broader reuse: principles should specify recurring support needs precisely enough to guide construction while leaving their implementation adaptable. Separating support principles from executable realizations provides a concrete basis for studying this balance.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个基准测试中，将经验泛化到新的任务。 银行从每个基准测试中约 10% 的指南构建中学习，并利用其余保留的实例进行构建；在所有六种设置中，全银行方法相较于无技能构建均有改进。 这证明了积累的经验对于已知类别和机制内的新任务具有实用价值，涵盖工作流程执行和科学发现两个方面。 跨数据集的重用是超出当前评估范围的合理延伸，留待未来研究。 一个有前景的假设是，技能颗粒度是更广泛重用的核心：原则应足够精确地指定重复出现的支持需求以指导构建，同时保持其实现方式的灵活性。 将支持原则与可执行的实现分离，为研究这一平衡关系提供了具体的基础。

paragraphs.en: Transfer as reuse across Builder–Target configurations. Our transfer study examines reuse of a frozen bank when the Builder or the Builder–Target pair changes. Effects are measured against concurrent no-skill runs of the receiving Builder and interpreted through paired confidence intervals. Cross-Builder-and-Target transfer yields positive point estimates on both benchmarks, illustrating promising reuse across selected model combinations. The broader results establish the feasibility of sharing principles while showing that their realized utility depends on the receiving configuration, with performance benefits qualified by the reported uncertainty. Recipient-side learning offers a complementary route for aligning support principles with a Builder’s own implementations.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Builder–Target 配置之间进行迁移，即实现复用。 我们的迁移研究探讨了当 Builder 或 Builder–Target 组合发生变化时，如何复用已冻结的模型库。 我们将效果与接收端 Builder 在无技能支持下的并行运行结果进行比较，并通过成对置信区间进行解读。 跨 Builder 和 Target 的迁移在两项基准测试中均产生了正向的点估计值，表明在选定的模型组合中具备良好的复用潜力。 更广泛的结果证实了共享原则的可行性，同时也表明其实际效用取决于接收端的配置，且性能提升受报告不确定性的影响。 接收端的学习为将支持原则与 Builder 自身的实现方式相协调提供了另一种补充途径。

paragraphs.en: A simple foundation for meta-skill evolution. We adopt a simple initial evolution mechanism to make the contribution of experience directly assessable. Starting from an empty bank, the Builder constructs harnesses, reviews Target execution, and makes one evidence-grounded decision per development task: keep, revise, or add. Two development passes produce the bank used for evaluation. Held-out gains demonstrate that useful support principles can emerge through this lightweight procedure, while same-model experiments extend the result to self-improvement without a stronger external teacher. The refinement curves show that update effects depend on the Target and task, motivating future advances in selective revision and retention on top of this working foundation.
paragraphs.zh: 元技能演化的一个简单基础。 我们采用一种简单的初始演化机制，使经验的作用可以直接评估。 从一个空白的知识库开始，构建者会创建工具、审查目标执行过程，并在每个开发任务中做出一个基于证据的决定：保留、修改或添加。 经过两轮开发流程后，便形成了用于评估的知识库。 预留测试集上的增益表明，通过这一轻量级流程可以产生有用的支持原则；而同一模型内的实验则进一步证明，无需更强大的外部教师，模型也能实现自我改进。 优化曲线显示，更新效果取决于目标和任务，这为在此有效基础之上进一步发展选择性修改与保留机制提供了动力。

paragraphs.en: Support design as the object of learning. This work studies learning that changes the knowledge and execution environments surrounding fixed models. The reported improvements therefore concern the resulting Builder–Target system, including system-level self-improvement when the same model serves both roles. The meta-skill representation and component interfaces provide a concrete instantiation of this learning problem within a shared design space. Our contribution establishes the usefulness of this route under the evaluated conditions and provides a reference point for studying alternative support representations and construction policies. A complementary direction is to combine Builder learning with improvements to the Target itself, allowing task-solving capabilities and the support that makes them effective to develop together.

paragraphs.en: Empirical scope and explanatory claims. We evaluate end-to-end task performance, encompassing both benchmark correctness and the execution processes needed to achieve it. Component analyses examine contributions within the generated harnesses, while case studies illustrate concrete ways in which support changes execution. paragraphs.en: Generality through shared support needs. The main generalization claim concerns new instances within known workflow categories and physical mechanisms; the model-transfer studies provide exploratory evidence for selected receiving configurations. Extending reuse across datasets, unseen task families, and different tool interfaces is a promising next step. One hypothesis is that the scope of a principle depends strongly on the granularity at which it describes a support need. For example, preserving evidence after a tool failure may be useful across domains even when the appropriate storage and recovery mechanisms differ. Studying this separation between a reusable need and its local implementation could clarify when principles transfer directly, when recipient-side adaptation helps, and how to learn banks that serve broader collections of tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 通过共享支持需求实现普适性。 主要泛化主张涉及已知工作流程类别和物理机制内的新实例；模型迁移研究为选定的接收配置提供了探索性证据。 将重复使用扩展到不同数据集、未见过的任务类型以及不同的工具接口，是一个有前景的下一步。 一种假设是，某项原则的适用范围在很大程度上取决于其描述支持需求时的粒度。 例如，即使适当的存储和恢复机制存在差异，在工具故障后保留证据可能在不同领域都有用。 研究可重复使用的需求与其本地实现之间的这种分离，或许能阐明原则何时可以直接迁移、接收方侧的适应何时会有帮助，以及如何学习能够服务于更广泛任务集合的知识库。

paragraphs.en: Evolution over longer learning histories. The current two-pass development procedure followed by frozen-bank deployment demonstrates that a bounded amount of experience can improve subsequent harness construction. Extending this setting to longer task streams would allow study of how useful principles are retained, revised, and combined as experience accumulates. The observed variation between refinement passes motivates development-based assessment of candidate updates and selective retention of successful guidance. Larger banks also create opportunities for adaptive retrieval and skill composition, extending the current comparison of full-bank access and BM25 top-2 retrieval. These directions would develop the present initial mechanism into a learning process suited to longer histories and changing support needs.
paragraphs.zh: 在更长的学习历史中实现演化。 当前由 frozen-bank 部署所遵循的两阶段开发流程表明，有限量的经验能够改进后续工具构建过程。 将这一设置扩展到更长的任务序列，将有助于研究有效原则如何在经验积累过程中被保留、修正和组合。 各精炼阶段之间观察到的差异，推动了基于开发的候选更新评估方法以及成功指导策略的选择性保留机制的发展。 更大的知识库也为自适应检索与技能组合创造了机会，从而拓展了当前对完整知识库访问与 BM25 前 2 名检索的对比研究。 这些方向将把目前的初始机制发展为一种适合更长历史记录和动态支持需求的学習过程。

paragraphs.en: Performance objectives and deployment conditions. The experiments study performance under fixed Target interaction limits, with Builder learning and construction providing support outside that execution budget. This setting makes the value of prepared support assessable for a given Target operating under the same interaction constraints. The supported performance claim uses this budget definition. For deployment, a complementary objective is to allocate a joint compute or latency budget across learning, construction, and execution according to the workload. Future work can study how reuse of learned banks, caching of common support components, and task-adaptive construction effort affect this allocation, connecting the demonstrated performance benefits to different deployment requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 性能目标与部署条件。 实验研究了在固定的目标交互限制下的性能，其中构建器学习和构建过程在该执行预算之外提供支持。 这种设置使得在相同交互约束下运行的特定目标，其已准备支持的价值变得可评估。 所支持的性能主张基于这一定义的预算。 在部署方面，一个互补的目标是根据工作负载，将联合计算或延迟预算分配给学习、构建和执行环节。 未来的研究可以探讨如何复用已学习的模型库、缓存通用支持组件以及任务自适应的构建努力，从而影响这种分配，并将所证明的性能优势与不同的部署需求联系起来。

paragraphs.en: For each benchmark, we reserve a development set of approximately 10% of the instances for meta-skill learning and use the remainder for testing. We determine the development-set size by rounding ten percent of the total to the nearest integer, with ties rounded up, and allocate proportional integer quotas across the public Harness-Bench categories and NewtonBench domains. This partitioning evaluates generalization to held-out instances within known categories and mechanisms. We use no separate validation partition, and the learned skill bank is frozen before testing, with no revisions based on test outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个基准测试，我们都会保留约 10% 的实例作为开发集用于元技能学习，其余部分则用于测试。 我们通过将总数量的百分之十四舍五入到最接近的整数（若存在小数则向上取整）来确定开发集的大小，并按比例分配整数配额至公开的 Harness-Bench 类别和 NewtonBench 领域。 这种划分方式评估了模型在已知类别和机制中被保留实例上的泛化能力。 我们没有使用独立的验证集，且在学习完成后，技能库在测试前即被冻结，不会根据测试结果进行任何修改。

paragraphs.en: Each meta-skill contains when , provide , and use fields, with a combined limit of 192 tokens. During learning, the Builder receives the entire current bank and updates it using evidence from learning episodes. The actual submission, or its absence, serves as the primary evidence, interpreted alongside the public task requirements, complete input–observation pairs, public errors, final artifacts, and support delivered by the harness. Each update produces a single decision: keep the bank unchanged, revise an existing skill, or add a new skill. A revision must identify the existing skill and the current evidence motivating the change; superseded versions remain archived. Neither private reference answers nor researcher-written diagnoses are provided during this process.
paragraphs.zh: 每个元技能都包含“何时”、“提供”和“使用”字段，总令牌数上限为 192。 在学习过程中，构建者会接收当前的完整技能库，并利用学习回合中的证据对其进行更新。 实际的提交结果（或无提交）是主要证据，该证据将与公开的任务要求、完整的输入-观察对、公开的错误、最终产物以及支持框架提供的帮助共同进行解读。 每次更新都会产生一个单一决策：保持技能库不变、修改现有技能，或添加新技能。 任何修改都必须指明被修改的现有技能以及促使变更的当前证据；被取代的版本仍会保留在存档中。 在此过程中，既不提供私密的参考答案，也不提供研究人员撰写的诊断说明。

paragraphs.en: At deployment, BM25 queries the skill bank using only the initial public task prompt and retrieves at most two skills with positive match scores. Harness construction receives the public initial task, neutral component interfaces, and the assigned semantic skill pack. The Builder has no access to test trajectories, scores, reference answers, or evaluator internals, so construction depends entirely on the information available before Target execution.

paragraphs.en: Harness construction allows up to 16K output tokens, with at most two repair attempts for candidates that violate the component interfaces. Each skill-update call allows up to 8K output tokens and returns the single keep, revise, or add decision described above. Target execution follows the benchmark-specific resource allowances listed below; these allowances are identical across experiment settings.

paragraphs.en: All reported aggregates use a fixed denominator containing every declared test task. When a run yields a valid native benchmark score, we retain that score, including zero. When construction or execution fails to yield a valid result, the task contributes zero to the system-level aggregate. This rule covers missing source bindings, infrastructure failures, and unresolved technical outcomes. The Builder and Target may attempt repairs within their permitted limits, but a run that remains unsuccessful or exceeds its total budget is still counted as zero. Thus, the absence of a native score never removes a task from the reported denominator.

paragraphs.en: Retrieved versus full-bank access. These variants use the same learned content and differ only in how much of it is supplied at deployment. If no skill receives a positive score, the resulting pack is empty. For free-form trajectory-mined notes, retrieval operates on natural paragraphs, while full-text access provides the complete notes. Holding the learned content fixed allows this comparison to assess selective versus comprehensive delivery without changing the learning procedure.

paragraphs.en: No-skill Builder. To separate the contribution of construction from that of learned experience, GPT-5.6-Sol constructs a fresh harness for each public task using an empty skill pack. The Builder otherwise retains the same seven component families, construction instructions, and information about the Target as our method, together with the same allowance of 16K output tokens and at most two interface-repair attempts. This baseline preserves the Builder’s ability to design support while removing access to learned meta-skills. For Gemini on Harness-Bench, performance increases from 37.35 in the native environment to 53.29 with no-skill construction, and then to 67.81 with our method. The first improvement captures the benefit of construction alone; the second captures the additional benefit of learned experience under the same construction interface.

paragraphs.en: Direct Builder skills. This baseline supplies the Target with the same meta-skill pack that the Builder receives in the corresponding variant of our method. No Builder-generated callbacks or resources are installed. The comparison thus holds access to learned knowledge fixed while changing whether a separate Builder implements that knowledge as harness support. Our full-bank method achieves higher scores in all six original settings, including 67.81 versus 42.38 for Gemini on Harness-Bench. These results support the benefit of having the Builder translate meta-skill guidance into concrete support before Target execution.

paragraphs.en: Independent Structured Target skills. This baseline learns skills specifically for the Target’s own problem-solving, using a separate GPT-5.6-Sol learner with no access to our Builder’s programs, trajectories, or meta-skill bank. Learning proceeds over two passes through the development set: the Target executes tasks in the neutral environment, and its current skill bank is supplied to subsequent executions as updates accumulate. Each update allows up to 8K output tokens and at most one skill addition or revision, with each skill limited to 192 tokens. The resulting bank is frozen and delivered directly to the Target at test time. Here, “independent” refers to the separately collected experience and separately learned bank; the extraction model remains the same. This baseline compares learning guidance for the Target’s task-solving procedures with learning principles for the Builder’s support design. Direct Target skill learning is competitive in several settings: Qwen scores 72.89 on Harness-Bench compared with our method’s 74.81, while Gemini scores 67.81 on NewtonBench compared with 68.84.

paragraphs.en: Mined Free-Form Target skills. This baseline also uses GPT-5.6-Sol to extract problem-solving advice from independent Target experience, but replaces iterative structured updates with a single offline consolidation step. The Target first completes one pass through the development set, after which the learner consolidates all resulting trajectories into a note of at most 3K tokens. The learner freely chooses the content, format, and organization of this note, without prescribed skill fields or explicit add, revise, and keep operations. At test time, the frozen notes are supplied directly to the Target, with no separate harness construction or Builder-generated components. Results vary across Target–benchmark settings. On Harness-Bench, GPT-OSS scores 66.01 with free-form notes, compared with 56.63 with Independent Structured Target skills. On NewtonBench, Gemini scores 41.44 with free-form notes, compared with 67.81 with structured Target skills and 68.84 with our method. These comparisons show that the relative effectiveness of static free-form advice and iteratively learned structured skills depends on the evaluation settings and models.

paragraphs.en: We present two successful full-bank test episodes with GPT-5.6-Sol as Builder and Gemini-3.6-Flash as Target . They illustrate complementary forms of support design: constructing a task-specific executable checker and coordinating an existing scientific interface through memory and control. Each case traces how a learned meta-skill informs the generated harness and how that support is used during Target execution. These selected cases provide qualitative insight into the resulting workflows, without estimating typical success rates or isolating the causal contributions of individual components.
paragraphs.zh: 我们展示了两个使用 GPT-5.6-Sol 作为构建者、Gemini-3.6-Flash 作为目标的成功全银行测试实例。 这些实例说明了两种互补的支持设计形式：构建特定任务的执行检查器，以及通过记忆和控制协调现有的科学接口。 每个案例都追溯了已学习的元技能如何指导生成的支持框架，以及这种支持在目标执行过程中如何被使用。 这些精选案例为最终的工作流程提供了定性见解，但并未估算典型的成功率或分离单个组件的因果贡献。

paragraphs.en: In this work, LLMs are used strictly for research support rather than as sources of substantive content. Their use falls into three categories: (i) providing tested results on our AI4AI at test-time framework, and (ii) assisting with language refinement during paper writing. For writing support, we used ChatGPT solely to polish text (improving coherence and grammar) while all ideas, logic, results, and technical contributions originate from the authors. To safeguard rigor, we have carefully reviewed all LLM-refined texts to confirm that no hallucinated content was introduced and that the original arguments, findings, and perspectives were faithfully preserved.
paragraphs.zh: 在本项工作中，大型语言模型（LLM）仅用于研究支持，而非作为实质性内容的来源。 其使用分为三类：(i) 在测试时为我们的 AI4AI 框架提供经过验证的结果，以及 (ii) 在论文撰写过程中协助语言润色。 在写作支持方面，我们仅使用 ChatGPT 来润色文本（提升连贯性和语法正确性），而所有观点、逻辑、结果和技术贡献均源自作者本人。 为确保严谨性，我们仔细审查了所有经 LLM 润色的文本，以确认未引入任何幻觉内容，且原始论点、发现与视角均得到了忠实保留。
